blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Scattered light is common in biomedical images, yet its removal remains challenging. The difficulty arises from three aspects: first, aligned scattered-light-free biomedical ground truth is often unavailable; second, scattering is coupled with weak illumination and sensor-induced noise; and third, many learning-based restoration models are computationally expensive for embedded devices in Internet of Medical Things (IoMT) scenarios. To address these issues, this paper proposes PP-Net, a hybrid physical-prior neural network for biomedical scattered light removal. The proposed method consists of three components: DFN-Net suppresses sensor-induced noise, ASAP estimates the scattering map and recovers a physics-based prior map, and GF-Net refines the prior map by fusing it with the denoised observation. To reduce the dependence on paired biomedical ground truth, a progressive synthetic training and cross-domain transfer strategy is developed. Experiments show that the physical-prior branch improves the peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) by up to 1.26 dB on paired synthetic benchmarks. Under joint noise-and-scattering degradation, PP-Net improves PSNR by more than 10.8 dB and the structural similarity index measure (SSIM) by more than 0.62 compared with representative baseline methods. On real W2S biomedical images, the proposed method reduces the average Natural Image Quality Evaluator (NIQE) score by 43.3%. Edge deployment with RKNN conversion and INT8 quantization achieves an average inference latency of approximately 200 ms per 512 × 512 512\times 512 image over 360 test images. These results demonstrate that PP-Net provides an effective and deployable solution for microscopic imaging, endoscopic inspection, and edge-assisted biomedical analysis in IoMT scenarios.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Scattered light is a common phenomenon in optical imaging. In natural environments, light scattering caused by atmospheric particles, aerosols, water droplets, and other turbid media often produces haze-like degradation, reducing image contrast and obscuring scene details. Similar scattering effects also exist in biomedical imaging, where photons interact with biological tissues, cellular structures, and heterogeneous media during acquisition. Unlike natural scene imaging, however, biomedical imaging is often performed under weak, localized, and safety-constrained illumination, making the captured images more vulnerable to scattering corruption, low signal-to-noise ratios, and sensor-induced noise.
blocks.zh: 散射光是光学成像中常见的现象. 在自然环境中,大气颗粒、气溶胶、水滴和其他扰动介质引起的光散射往往产生类似雾霾的降解,降低图像对比,并模糊场景细节。 生物医学成像中也存在类似的散射效应,光子在获取过程中与生物组织,细胞结构和多种介质相互作用. 然而,与自然场景成像不同,生物医学成像往往在薄弱、局部和安全受限的照明下进行,使捕获的图像更易于分散腐败、信号与噪音比率低以及传感器引起的噪音。

blocks.en: In Internet of Medical Things (IoMT) scenarios, biomedical imaging devices such as endoscopes and microscopes serve as front-end sensing nodes for clinical observation, remote diagnosis, and downstream visual analysis [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 ] . Degraded images may blur tissue boundaries, reduce structural visibility, and obscure diagnostically relevant details. Meanwhile, practical IoMT systems require not only accurate restoration but also reduced dependence on paired biomedical ground truth, efficient inference, and feasible deployment on resource-constrained edge devices. These requirements motivate a restoration method that integrates physical interpretability, deep feature refinement, and edge-oriented efficiency.
blocks.zh: 在医疗物联网(IOMT)场景中,内视镜和显微镜等生物医学成像设备作为临床观测,远程诊断,下游视觉分析的前端感知节点[1,2,3,4]. 退化的图像可能会模糊组织界限,降低结构能见度,模糊诊断相关细节. 同时,实用的IOMT系统不仅需要准确的恢复,而且需要减少对配对生物医学地面真理的依赖、有效的推论和在受资源限制的边缘装置上可行的部署。 这些要求促使采用一种恢复方法,将物理可解释性、深度特征改进和面向边缘的效率结合起来。

blocks.en: I-A From Natural Scattering to Biomedical Imaging
blocks.zh: 从自然扫射到生物医学成像

blocks.en: In natural image processing, scattered light is commonly studied in the form of haze or atmospheric scattering. Classical dehazing methods usually rely on an image formation model that relates the observed hazy image to scene radiance, transmission, and atmospheric light. Based on this model, a variety of physical priors have been developed to estimate the scattering component and recover the latent clear image. Among them, the dark channel prior (DCP) has become a representative approach because of its simplicity, interpretability, and strong empirical performance in natural scenes [ 5 ] .
blocks.zh: 在自然图像处理中,散射光通常以雾霾或大气散射的形式研究. 古典解析方法通常依赖于一种图像形成模型,将观测到的模糊图像与场景光线,传输,大气光线联系起来. 在这个模型的基础上,开发了各种物理前兆,以估计散射成分并恢复潜在的清晰图像。 其中,前暗通道(DCP)因其在自然场景中的简单,可诠释性,以及强烈的经验性表现[5]而成为具有代表性的方法.

blocks.en: Although natural image dehazing and biomedical scattered-light removal share similar physical intuition, the two problems are not identical. In natural scenes, paired hazy and haze-free images can often be synthesized or approximated using outdoor image formation models. In biomedical imaging, however, scattering is usually coupled with tissue morphology, weak illumination, sensor noise, and device-dependent acquisition conditions. More importantly, strictly aligned scattering-free biomedical ground truth is generally unavailable in real clinical settings. Therefore, methods designed for natural dehazing cannot be directly transferred to biomedical scattered-light removal without considering the specific degradation characteristics of biomedical images.
blocks.zh: 虽然自然影像解析和生物医学散射光去除具有相似的物理直觉,但这两个问题并不相同. 在自然场景中,成对的无烟雾图像往往可以使用室外图像形成模型合成或大致合成. 然而,在生物医学成像中,散射通常与组织形态学,弱光度,感应噪声,以及设备依赖的获取条件相伴. 更重要的是,在真实的临床环境中,通常无法找到严格一致的无生物医学分布的地面真相。 因此,在不考虑生物医学图像的具体降解特征的情况下,自然脱衣方法不能直接转移到生物医学散射光清除.

blocks.en: I-B Physical Priors for Scattered-Light Removal
blocks.zh: 散射光清除的物理前科

blocks.en: Physical-prior-based methods are attractive for scattered-light removal because they provide interpretable intermediate estimates and do not necessarily require large-scale paired training data. In natural image dehazing, DCP-based methods and their variants estimate scattering-related statistics from local image neighborhoods [ 5 , 6 , 7 ] . Similar ideas have also inspired biomedical scattered-light removal, where prior-based estimation can provide physically meaningful guidance when clean targets are unavailable [ 8 , 9 , 4 ] .
blocks.zh: 以物理为主的方法对散光去除具有吸引力,因为它们提供了可解释的中间估计,并不一定需要大规模配对训练数据. 在自然图像解析中,基于DCP的方法及其变体估计了来自当地图像街区的散射相关统计数据[5,6,7]. 类似的想法也启发了生物医学散射光去除,在没有清洁目标时,事先作出的估计可以提供实际有意义的指导[8,9,4].

blocks.en: However, conventional priors remain limited in biomedical scenarios. First, fixed-window estimation may cross tissue boundaries and introduce boundary leakage or edge-shifting artifacts. Second, dark-channel statistics can be corrupted by high-frequency sensor noise and heterogeneous tissue textures. Third, biomedical images often contain fine structural details and irregular local transitions, making a single fixed neighborhood insufficient for reliable scattering estimation. These limitations suggest that the prior estimation mechanism should be adapted to local biomedical structures rather than relying on a fixed support window. This motivates the adaptive scattering-prior estimation strategy adopted in this work.
blocks.zh: 然而,在生物医学假设中,传统前科仍然有限。 首先,固定窗口估计可能跨越组织界限,引入边界渗漏或边缘转移文物。 其次,暗通道统计可能会被高频传感器噪声和各种组织纹理所腐蚀. 第三,生物医学图像往往包含精细的结构细节和不规则的局部过渡,使得单一的固定街区不足以进行可靠的分散估计. 这些限制表明,先前的估计机制应当适应当地的生物医学结构,而不是依赖固定的支助窗口。 这推动了在这项工作中采用的适应性分散优先估计战略。

blocks.en: I-C Deep Restoration Under Biomedical Constraints
blocks.zh: I-C 生物医学限制下的深度恢复

blocks.en: Deep learning has significantly advanced image restoration, including denoising, deblurring, dehazing, low-light enhancement, and general image reconstruction [ 10 , 11 , 12 ] . Compared with handcrafted priors, deep models provide stronger nonlinear representation capability and can recover complex local textures from degraded observations. For scattered-light removal, learning-based refinement is particularly useful because a physical prior alone may not fully restore subtle tissue details or suppress residual artifacts.
blocks.zh: 深度学习有显著进步的图像修复,包括去诺化,脱色,低光增强,以及一般图像重建[10,11,12]. 与手工前科相比,深层模型提供了更强的非线性表现能力,并且可以从退化的观测中恢复复杂的局部纹理. 对于散射光的清除,基于学习的改进特别有用,因为单靠物理上的先导可能无法完全恢复微妙的组织细节或抑制残余文物.

blocks.en: Nevertheless, fully supervised deep restoration is difficult to apply directly to biomedical scattered-light removal. Most supervised restoration networks require paired degraded and clean images, whereas scattering-free biomedical ground truth is rarely available in real acquisition settings. In addition, models trained on synthetic data may suffer from domain gaps when transferred to real biomedical images. Recent weakly supervised, unsupervised, and cross-domain restoration strategies have attempted to reduce this dependence on paired data [ 13 , 14 , 15 ] . However, without a stable physical constraint, cross-domain restoration may generate structurally inconsistent or diagnostically unreliable details. These observations motivate a hybrid design that combines physical-prior guidance with deep restoration.
blocks.zh: 然而,完全监督的深度恢复很难直接适用于生物医学散射光的清除。 大多数受监督的恢复网络需要成对的退化和干净的图像,而在真正的获取环境中,很少有分散的免费生物医学地面真相。 此外,在合成数据方面受过培训的模型在转移到真正的生物医学图像时可能会出现域间隙。 近期监督不力、不受监督、跨领域恢复战略试图减少对配对数据的依赖[13、14、15]。 然而,如果没有稳定的物理约束,跨域修复可能会产生结构不一致或诊断不可靠的细节. 这些观测激发了结合物理前导和深修复的混合设计.

blocks.en: I-D Biomedical Restoration on Embedded Devices
blocks.zh: I-D 嵌入式设备的生物医学修复

blocks.en: Beyond restoration quality, practical deployment is an important requirement in IoMT-oriented biomedical imaging. Edge-side processing can reduce data transmission, preserve privacy, and support local visual enhancement in bandwidth-constrained or delay-sensitive scenarios. However, high-performance deep restoration networks are often computationally intensive, which limits their deployment on resource-constrained edge devices. Therefore, biomedical scattered-light removal methods for IoMT applications should be designed with both restoration accuracy and computational efficiency in mind.
blocks.zh: 除了修复质量外,实际部署是IOMT导向生物医学成像的重要要求. 边边处理可以减少数据传输,保持隐私,并在带宽受限或延迟敏感的情况下支持局部视觉增强. 然而,高性能的深度恢复网络往往在计算上密集,这限制了其在资源紧张的边缘设备上的部署. 因此,在设计用于IOMT应用的生物医学散射光清除方法时,应考虑到恢复准确性和计算效率。

blocks.en: Existing lightweight restoration models improve inference efficiency through compact backbones, efficient convolutions, and deployment-oriented optimization [ 16 , 17 ] . However, many of them are designed for general natural-image restoration and do not explicitly address biomedical scattering, sensor noise, limited paired supervision, and physical interpretability at the same time. This creates a need for an edge-oriented biomedical restoration framework that is both physically meaningful and computationally practical.
blocks.zh: 现有的轻量级修复模型通过紧凑的骨干,高效的演化,以及面向部署的优化[16,17],提高了推论效率. 然而,其中许多是针对一般自然图像修复设计的,没有明确涉及生物医学散射、感官噪音、有限的对映监督以及同时的物理解释。 这就需要有一个面向边缘的生物医学修复框架,这种框架在物理上有意义,在计算上实用。

blocks.en: I-E Motivations and Contributions
blocks.zh: I-E 动机和贡献

blocks.en: The above analysis shows that biomedical scattered-light removal in IoMT scenarios requires a framework that can jointly address scattering corruption, sensor-induced noise, limited paired supervision, and edge-side deployment constraints. Physical priors provide interpretability but are sensitive to noise and local structural variations. Deep restoration models provide strong representation capability but usually require paired clean targets and may be difficult to deploy on resource-constrained devices. These challenges motivate the proposed PP-Net, a hybrid physical-prior neural network for biomedical scattered-light removal.
blocks.zh: 上述分析表明,在IOMT情景中,生物医学散射光去除需要有一个框架,可以共同解决散射腐败、传感器引起的噪音、有限的对联监督以及边缘部署限制等问题。 物理前科提供可解释性,但对噪音和局部结构变化敏感。 深度恢复模型提供强大的代表能力,但通常需要配对的清洁目标,可能难以在资源紧张的装置上部署。 这些挑战促使拟议中的PP-Net,即生物医学分散光去除的混合物理前神经网络。

blocks.en: PP-Net follows a progressive network-prior-network design. A Denoising Front-End Network (DFN-Net), implemented using FFDNet [ 18 ] , first suppresses sensor-induced noise. An Advanced Scattering Adaptive Prior (ASAP) module then estimates the scattering map and recovers a physics-based prior map in a physically interpretable manner. Finally, a Guided Fusion Network (GF-Net) refines the prior map by fusing it with the denoised observation. To reduce the dependence on paired biomedical ground truth, we further develop a progressive synthetic training and cross-domain transfer strategy.
blocks.zh: PP-Net采用渐进式的网络前置网络设计. A Denoising Front-End Net(DFN-Net),使用FFDNet[18]执行,首先压制传感器引起的噪音. 然后,一个高级Scoutting adaptive Prior(ASAP)模块对散射图进行估计,并以实际可解释的方式恢复基于物理的先前地图。 最后,一个导引融合网络(GF-Net)通过将先前的地图与去声观测相连接来完善. 为了减少对配对生物医学地面真理的依赖,我们进一步发展了渐进合成训练和跨域转移战略.

blocks.en: The contributions of this work are summarized as follows: • We formulate a noise-aware biomedical scattered-light degradation model that decomposes image degradation into tissue scattering and sensor-induced noise. • We propose PP-Net, a hybrid physical-prior neural network that integrates DFN-Net, ASAP, and GF-Net for biomedical scattered-light removal. • We develop a progressive synthetic training and cross-domain transfer strategy to reduce the dependence on paired biomedical ground-truth data. • We implement the proposed method on a resource-constrained edge device and verify its feasibility for edge-side biomedical image enhancement in IoMT scenarios.

blocks.en: This section presents the proposed hybrid pipeline for biomedical scattered-light removal. The framework integrates adaptive physics-based prior estimation, lightweight deep refinement, and progressive synthetic training. Given a degraded biomedical image, the pipeline sequentially estimates a denoised observation, a scattering map, a physics-based prior map, and the final restored image. As shown in Fig. 1 , the framework consists of three stages: 1) initial noise suppression using DFN-Net, 2) scattering-map estimation and prior-map recovery using ASAP, and 3) high-fidelity prior-map refinement using GF-Net.
blocks.zh: 本节介绍拟议的生物医学散光清除混合管道。 该框架结合了基于适应物理学的先期估计,轻量级深度改进,以及渐进合成训练. 鉴于生物医学图像已退化,管道按顺序估计了无声观测、散射图、以物理为基础的先前地图和最后恢复的图像。 如图1所示,框架包括三个阶段: 1)使用DFN-Net进行初步噪声抑制,2)使用ASAP进行散射图估计和前图回收,3)使用GF-Net进行高精度前图改进.

blocks.en: For clarity, the branch composed of ASAP and GF-Net is denoted as PP-Net P , representing the physical-prior-guided restoration branch. The complete restoration method with DFN-Net, ASAP, and GF-Net is denoted as PP-Net.
blocks.zh: 为明确起见,由ASAP和GF-Net组成的分支称为PP-Net P,代表物理前导恢复分支。 DFN-Net、ASAP和GF-Net的完整恢复方法称为PP-Net。

blocks.zh: II-A 系统一级建筑和管道概览

blocks.en: To satisfy the low-latency and privacy-preserving requirements of IoMT applications, the proposed framework is designed for flexible deployment on either local edge devices or remote servers. As illustrated in Fig. 1 (a), raw biomedical images acquired by devices such as endoscopes and microscopes are first fed into the restoration pipeline. Depending on the application scenario, the pipeline can run on a local RK3588 edge node for edge-side enhancement or on a remote server for collaborative medical analysis.

blocks.en: II-C Initial Noise Suppression via DFN-Net
blocks.zh: II-C 通过DFN-Net进行初步噪声抑制

blocks.en: According to ( 3 ), the degraded biomedical image contains both scattering corruption and sensor-induced noise. Since sensor noise may distort local statistics and reduce the reliability of subsequent prior estimation, a dedicated denoising stage is introduced before scattering estimation.
blocks.zh: 根据(3),退化的生物医学图像既包含散布腐败,也包含传感器引起的噪音。 由于传感器噪声可能扭曲当地统计数据,降低随后的先前估计的可靠性,因此在分散估计之前引入了专门的去诺阶段.

blocks.en: To meet edge-side efficiency requirements, we employ DFN-Net, implemented using FFDNet [ 18 ] , as a lightweight feed-forward denoising front end. As shown in Fig. 1 (c), DFN-Net adopts a fully convolutional structure. The network first applies a 3 × 3 3\times 3 convolution followed by a PReLU activation to extract shallow features. The resulting feature maps are then processed by a sequence of dilated convolutional blocks with dilation factors D ∈ { 1 , 2 , 4 , 8 } D\in\{1,2,4,8\} .
blocks.zh: 为了满足边际效率要求,我们使用使用使用FFDNet[18]的DFN-Net,作为轻量级的Feed-forward调试前端. 如图1(c)所示,DFN-Net采用了一种完全革命的结构。 网络首先应用了3×3 3\times 3的演化,然后是PRELU激活以提取浅层特征. 生成的特征图随后由一系列膨胀的演化区块进行处理,其中的拓扑因子D {{1,2,4,8}D\in{1,2,4,8}.

blocks.en: The dilated design enlarges the receptive field with limited computational overhead. In addition, a residual learning strategy is adopted to encourage the network to focus on the noise component. After feature reconstruction using a final 3 × 3 3\times 3 convolution and PReLU activation, the denoised image T ⁡ ( x , y ) T(x,y) is obtained and passed to the subsequent prior estimation stage.
blocks.zh: 膨胀式设计以有限的计算间接费用扩大了可接受字段. 此外,还采取了一项剩余学习战略,鼓励网络注重噪音部分。 在使用最终的 3× 3 3\times 3 革命和 PRELU 激活进行特性重建后,获得去诺化的图像 T ⁡(x,y) T(x,y),并传递到随后的预估阶段.

blocks.en: Classical dark channel prior methods usually adopt a fixed local window to estimate transmission-related statistics [ 5 ] . However, biomedical images often contain complex structures, fine tissue boundaries, and heterogeneous textures. Under such conditions, fixed-window estimation may introduce boundary leakage and structural artifacts. To address this issue, we propose ASAP, which is derived from a multi-scale adaptive dark-channel estimation mechanism, as illustrated in Fig. 1 (d).

blocks.en: Instead of using a single fixed patch, ASAP evaluates multiple candidate windows with different scales and spatial morphologies for each target pixel. Specifically, the method considers multiple window sizes and nine spatial configurations, including full, half, and quarter window patterns. By adaptively selecting the most suitable local neighborhood, ASAP improves the robustness of scattering estimation while preserving local structural boundaries.

blocks.en: The resulting prior map removes the dominant scattering component and provides a physically interpretable intermediate representation. GF-Net then refines this prior map by fusing it with the denoised observation.
blocks.zh: 由此形成的前图消除了主散射元件,提供了实际可解释的中间代表. GF-Net然后通过将这个先前的地图与去通知的观测相连接来完善.

blocks.en: II-E Guided Fusion via GF-Net
blocks.zh: 通过GF-Net进行引导融合

blocks.en: Although the physics-based prior map attenuates the dominant scattering effects and recovers the global structure, it may still be insufficient for restoring subtle local details in complex biomedical tissues. To further improve restoration fidelity, we introduce a deep refinement stage based on GF-Net, as shown in Fig. 1 (e).
blocks.zh: 虽然以物理为基础的前图减轻了主要的散射效应并恢复了全球结构,但可能仍然不足以恢复复杂生物医学组织中微妙的局部细节。 为了进一步提高修复忠贞度,我们采用了基于GF-Net的深度完善阶段,如图1(e)所示。

blocks.en: GF-Net jointly exploits the denoised observation T ⁡ ( x , y ) T(x,y) and the prior map U map ​ ( x , y ) U_{\mathrm{map}}(x,y) . The two inputs are concatenated along the channel dimension and projected into a high-dimensional feature space through a 3 × 3 3\times 3 convolution. In this manner, the network can exploit both scattering-suppressed structural guidance and retained local texture cues.
blocks.zh: GF-Net 联合利用已取消的观测 T ⁡ (x, y) T(x, y) 和先前的地图 U 地图 (x, y) U _{\ mathrm{map}}(x, y). 两种输入沿通道维度缩合,通过3×3 3\times 3的演化投射到高维特征空间. 这样,网络既可以利用散射抑制的结构导线,也可以保留局部纹理提示.

blocks.en: To improve computational efficiency, GF-Net is built upon the nonlinear activation-free block (NAFB). Two operations are particularly important. First, the SimpleGate operation introduces nonlinearity through element-wise interactions between split feature channels. Second, simplified channel attention (SCA) recalibrates channel-wise feature importance using global average pooling and a lightweight 1 × 1 1\times 1 convolution.
blocks.zh: 为了提高计算效率,GF-Net建立在非线性无激活区块(NAFB)上. 两项行动特别重要。 首先,SimpleGate操作通过分裂特性通道之间的元素-任意交互引入非线性. 第二,简化信道注意度(SCA)利用全球平均集合和轻量级1×1 1\times 1 演化来调整信道的特性重要性。

blocks.en: At the network level, GF-Net adopts a four-level encoder–decoder architecture with skip connections. The hierarchical design enlarges the receptive field and facilitates multi-scale fusion, while the skip connections help preserve spatial information. In addition, a global residual connection is introduced so that the network learns a residual correction with respect to the prior map and the denoised observation.
blocks.zh: 在网络层面,GF-Net采用了带有跳过连接的四级编码器-解码器架构. 分级设计可以扩大可接受领域,促进多尺度的聚变,而跳过连接有助于保存空间信息. 此外,还引入了全球剩余连接,使该网络能够了解先前地图和无名观察的剩余更正。

blocks.en: II-F Progressive Synthetic Training and Cross-Domain Transfer Strategy
blocks.zh: 二-F 逐步合成培训和跨领域转移战略

blocks.en: A major challenge in biomedical image restoration is the lack of paired degraded/clean data in real clinical environments. Instead of directly performing supervised training on biomedical images, we adopt a progressive synthetic training strategy and then transfer the trained model to real biomedical images for inference. This design is motivated by two considerations: paired scattering-free biomedical ground truth is generally unavailable, and the denoising front end is required only when scattering and sensor noise coexist.
blocks.zh: 生物医学图像恢复方面的一个主要挑战是缺乏真实临床环境中的对称退化/清洁数据。 我们没有直接进行关于生物医学图像的有监督的培训,而是采取了一种渐进的合成培训战略,然后将经过培训的模型转移到真正的生物医学图像中进行推论。 这种设计是出于两个考虑:配对的散射无生物医学地面真理一般是没有的,只有在散射和传感器噪声共存时才需要去诺前端.

blocks.en: To match the structure of the proposed framework, the training process is divided into two stages. In the first stage, PP-Net P is trained for physical-prior-guided restoration under scattering-dominated degradation without explicit sensor noise. In the second stage, mixed synthetic noise is introduced to train the complete PP-Net for joint scattered-light removal and noise suppression. After this progressive two-stage training, the trained PP-Net is directly applied to real biomedical images for cross-domain inference and evaluation.
blocks.zh: 为了配合拟议框架的结构,培训进程分为两个阶段。 在第一阶段,PP-Net P在散射为主的降解下接受物理前导修复培训,没有明显的传感器噪音。 在第二阶段,采用了混合合成噪声来训练完整的PP-Net,用于联合散射光去除和噪声抑制. 经过这一渐进的两阶段培训后,经过培训的PP-Net直接应用于真正的生物医学图像,用于跨域推论和评价.

blocks.en: II-F 1 Stage I: Synthetic Training of PP-Net P
blocks.zh: II-F 1 第一阶段:PP-Net P的合成培训

blocks.en: In the first stage, the model is trained on the ITS subset of RESIDE [ 19 ] to learn prior-guided restoration from paired synthetic data. Since this stage considers scattering-dominated degradation without explicit sensor noise, only ASAP and GF-Net are used. ASAP estimates the scattering map and recovers a physics-based prior map from the degraded input, and GF-Net refines the prior map to recover the restored image. The resulting physical-prior branch is denoted as PP-Net P .
blocks.zh: 在第一阶段,该模型被培训到ITS子集RESIDE[19]上,从配对合成数据中学习前导修复. 由于这一阶段考虑散射为主的降解,而没有明确的传感器噪音,因此只使用ASAP和GF-Net。 ASAP估计散射图,从退化的输入中恢复基于物理的前图,GF-Net精炼前图以恢复恢复的图像. 由此产生的物理先导分支表示为PP-Net P。

II-F 2 Stage II: Synthetic Training of PP-Net Under Joint Noise-and-Scattering Degradation
blocks.zh: II-F 2 第二阶段:联合噪声和散乱退化下的PP-Net合成培训

blocks.en: Although the first stage provides a useful initialization, practical biomedical image acquisition often involves both scattering degradation and sensor-induced noise. To simulate this condition, we add mixed Poisson–Gaussian noise to the ITS images and train the complete PP-Net pipeline. In this stage, DFN-Net suppresses sensor-induced noise, ASAP estimates the scattering map and recovers a physics-based prior map, and GF-Net refines the prior map by fusing it with the denoised observation. The mixed noise model approximates photon fluctuations and sensor noise commonly observed in biomedical imaging.
blocks.zh: 尽管第一阶段提供了有用的初始化,但实际的生物医学图像获取往往既涉及散射降解,也涉及传感器引起的噪音。 为了模拟这种情况,我们在ITS的图像中加入了混杂的Poisson-Gausian噪声,并训练完整的PP-Net管道. 在这一阶段,DFN-Net压制传感器引起的噪音,ASAP估计散射图并恢复基于物理学的先前地图,GF-Net通过将前地图与去诺化的观测相连接来完善. 混合噪声模型近似于生物医学成像中常见的光子波动和传感器噪声.

This stage enables PP-Net to jointly address scattering removal and noise suppression.

blocks.en: II-F 3 Cross-Domain Transfer to Real Biomedical Images
blocks.zh: II-F 3 跨领域转让给真正的生物医学 图像

blocks.en: After the two-stage training process, the resulting PP-Net is directly transferred to real biomedical images for cross-domain inference and evaluation. Since paired biomedical ground truth is unavailable during training, this step is treated as cross-domain transfer rather than supervised adaptation.
blocks.zh: 经过两阶段的训练过程后,由此产生的PP-Net直接转移到真实的生物医学图像上进行跨域推论和评价. 由于在培训期间无法获得生物医学地面的配对事实,这一步骤被视为跨域转移,而不是监督适应。

blocks.en: In summary, the proposed training strategy is consistent with the progressive structure of the restoration framework. The first stage establishes prior-guided restoration capability through PP-Net P , while the second stage introduces DFN-Net to form the complete PP-Net and improve robustness under joint noise-and-scattering degradation. The final trained PP-Net is then transferred to real biomedical images for inference and evaluation.
blocks.zh: 总之,拟议的培训战略符合复原框架的渐进结构。 第一阶段通过PP-Net P建立前导修复能力,第二阶段则引入DFN-Net,形成完整的PP-Net,并在联合噪声和散乱降解下提高稳健性. 最终经过培训的PP-Net随后被转移到真正的生物医学图像中进行推论和评价.

blocks.en: III Experiments
blocks.zh: 三 实验

blocks.en: This section evaluates the proposed framework from four aspects. First, we validate the effectiveness of the proposed ASAP module on multiple dehazing benchmarks. Second, we compare the proposed hybrid restoration framework with representative learning-based dehazing methods on paired synthetic datasets. Third, we investigate the robustness of the complete PP-Net under joint noise-and-scattering degradation. Finally, after progressive training on synthetic hazy and noisy-hazy data, we directly transfer the trained model to real biomedical images for qualitative analysis and no-reference image quality assessment.
blocks.zh: 本节从四个方面评价拟议框架。 第一,我们验证拟议的ASAP关于多种解码基准的模块的有效性。 第二,我们比较拟议的混合恢复框架和在配对合成数据集上具有代表性的基于学习的解析方法。 第三,我们调查整个PP-Net在联合噪声和散乱退化下的强度。 最后,经过关于合成的模糊和吵闹的数据的渐进训练,我们直接将经过训练的模型转移到真实的生物医学图像上,用于定性分析和无参考图像质量评估.

blocks.en: III-A Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: III-A 实验设置

blocks.en: Experiments are conducted on both synthetic dehazing benchmarks and real biomedical images. The evaluation is designed to examine the effectiveness of the proposed adaptive prior, the restoration capability of the hybrid framework, its robustness under noisy degradation, and its transferability to real biomedical imaging scenarios.
blocks.zh: 对合成除污基准和真正的生物医学图像进行了实验。 评估的目的是审查拟议的前期适应措施的有效性、混合框架的恢复能力、在吵闹的退化情况下的稳健性,以及可转移到真正的生物医学成像情景。

blocks.en: To validate the effectiveness of ASAP, we compare it with representative physics-based dehazing methods on five datasets: SOTS, HSTS, I-HAZE, O-HAZE, and D-HAZY. These datasets cover synthetic and real haze conditions, as well as indoor and outdoor scenes, thereby providing a comprehensive evaluation of prior-based scattering estimation.
blocks.zh: 为了验证ASAP的有效性,我们把它与具有代表性的物理解析方法在五个数据集上进行比较:SOTS,HSTS,I-HAZE,O-HAZE,和D-HAZY. 这些数据集涵盖合成和真实的雾霾条件以及室内和室外场景,从而对先前的散射估计提供了全面的评价.

blocks.en: To evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed physical-prior-guided restoration framework, we conduct experiments on the RESIDE-ITS and RESIDE-6K datasets. These two paired datasets are used to assess whether PP-Net P can outperform representative learning-based dehazing models under paired synthetic supervision.
blocks.zh: 为了评价拟议的物理前导修复框架的有效性,我们进行了RESIDE-ITS和RESIDE-6K数据集的实验。 这两个配对数据集用于评估PP-Net P能否在配对合成监督下超越具有代表性的基于学习的解析模型.

blocks.en: To simulate the noisy biomedical imaging scenario considered in this work, we construct noisy synthetic data by injecting mixed Poisson–Gaussian noise into hazy images. The Poisson scaling factor and Gaussian noise level are set to λ p = 30 \lambda_{p}=30 and σ g = 0.05 \sigma_{g}=0.05 , respectively. This setting is designed to assess the robustness of PP-Net when scattering degradation and sensor noise coexist.
blocks.zh: 为了模拟这部作品中考虑的吵闹的生物医学成像情景,我们通过将混杂的波森-古西语噪声注入模糊的图像来构建吵闹的合成数据. 普瓦松缩放因子和高斯噪声等级分别设定为 λ p = 30\lambda_{p}= + 30 和 σ g = 0.05\sigma_{g}= 0.05 . 这一设置旨在评估PP-Net在散射降解和传感器噪音共存时的稳健性。

blocks.en: To examine cross-domain transferability, we directly apply the trained model to multiple categories of real biomedical images. Since paired scattering-free biomedical ground truth is unavailable and no target-domain fine-tuning is performed, the biomedical experiments are used mainly for qualitative analysis and no-reference image quality assessment.
blocks.zh: 为了检查跨域可转让性,我们直接将训练有素的模型应用于多类真实的生物医学影像. 由于配对的散射无线生物医学地面真伪不可用,且没有进行目标领域微调,生物医学实验主要用于定性分析和无参考图像质量评估.

blocks.en: For synthetic datasets with paired references, PSNR and SSIM are adopted as full-reference evaluation metrics. For real biomedical images, NIQE and BRISQUE are used as no-reference quality metrics, where lower values indicate better perceptual quality.
blocks.zh: 对于配对参考物的合成数据集,PSNR和SSIM被采用为全参考评价度量衡. 对于真实的生物医学图像,NIQE和BRISQUE被用作无参考质量衡量标准,其中较低的数值表明有更好的认知质量.

blocks.en: III-A 1 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 执行细节

blocks.en: All experiments are conducted on a workstation equipped with four NVIDIA RTX 6000 Ada GPUs and an Intel Core i9-14900K CPU. The proposed model is implemented in PyTorch. Unless otherwise specified, the input patch size is set to 256 × 256 256\times 256 , the batch size is set to 32, and the Adam optimizer is used for training. The initial learning rate is set to 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} and is updated using the CosineAnnealingLR schedule. The total number of training epochs is set to 500.
blocks.zh: 所有实验都在一个配备4台NVIDIA RTX 6000 Ada GPU和一个Intel Core i9-14900K CPU的工作站上进行. 拟议模式在PyTorch实施。 除非另有说明,输入补丁大小设定为256×256256\times 256,批量大小设定为32,亚当优化器用于训练. 初始学习率设定为1×10−4 1\times 10×4},并使用CosineAnnealingLR时间表进行更新. 培训阶段的总数定为500个。

blocks.en: III-A 2 Baseline Methods
blocks.zh: 基准方法

blocks.en: To provide comprehensive comparisons, we consider two categories of baseline methods. For evaluating ASAP, we compare it with representative physics-based dehazing methods, including FVR [ 20 ] , DCP [ 5 ] , CAP [ 21 ] , MR [ 22 ] , CEP [ 23 ] , CC [ 24 ] , NLBF [ 25 ] , SLP [ 26 ] , ROP+ [ 27 ] , ALSP [ 28 ] , GLP [ 7 ] , and IHDCP [ 6 ] . For evaluating the proposed hybrid framework, we further compare it with representative learning-based dehazing methods, including MSCNN [ 29 ] , AOD-Net [ 11 ] , GFN [ 30 ] , MSBDN [ 31 ] , PFDN [ 32 ] , FFA-Net [ 33 ] , TBN [ 34 ] , CDVA [ 35 ] , IDB [ 36 ] , and MPMF-Net [ 37 ] . For the noisy degradation setting, the publicly available models of the compared learning-based methods are directly tested on the same noisy synthetic inputs without additional retraining, unless otherwise specified. For the W2S biomedical evaluation, we additionally compare with DCP [ 5 ] , HDCP [ 8 ] , QDCP [ 9 ] , and Dark [ 4 ] as representative prior-based or biomedical image enhancement baselines.
blocks.zh: 为了进行全面的比较,我们考虑了两类基准方法。 为了进行ASAP评价,我们将其与具有代表性的物理解析方法进行比较,包括FVR [20]、DCP [5]、CAP [21]、MR [22]、CEP [23]、CC [24]、NLF [25]、SLP [26]、ROP+ [27]、ALSP [28]、GLP [7]和IHDCP [6]。 为了评价拟议的混合框架,我们进一步将其与具有代表性的基于学习的解析方法进行比较,包括MSCNN[29]、AOD-Net[11]、GFN[30]、MSBDN[31]、PFDN[32]、FFA-Net[33]、TBN[34]、CDVA[35]、IDB[36]和MPMF-Net[37]。 对于吵闹的退化环境,除非另有说明,否则在同样的吵闹的合成投入上直接测试公开使用的比较学习方法模型。 关于W2S生物医学评价,我们与DCP [5],HDCP [8],QDCP [9],和Dark [4]作为具有代表性的前置或生物医学图像增强基线进行进一步比较.

blocks.en: III-A 3 Training and Transfer Setting
blocks.zh: III-A 3 培训和转让设置

blocks.en: The experimental protocol is consistent with the progressive synthetic training strategy described in Section II-F . Specifically, PP-Net P is first trained on paired synthetic hazy data to learn physical-prior-guided restoration without explicit sensor noise. Then, the complete PP-Net is trained on noisy synthetic data to handle joint noise-and-scattering degradation. After two-stage training, PP-Net is directly applied to real biomedical images for cross-domain inference and evaluation.
blocks.zh: 实验议定书符合第二节F部分所述的渐进合成培训战略。 具体来说,PP-Net P首先在配对合成的模糊数据上接受培训,以学习物理前导恢复,而不会有明显的传感器噪声. 之后,完整的PP-Net接受了关于噪音合成数据的培训,以处理噪音和挥发性联合降解。 经过两阶段培训,PP-Net直接应用于真实的生物医学图像,用于跨域推论和评价.

blocks.en: III-D Robustness of PP-Net Under Noisy Degradation
blocks.zh: 三-D 在噪声退化下PP-Net的强性

blocks.en: To evaluate robustness under joint haze-and-noise degradation, we further test PP-Net on noisy ITS and noisy RESIDE-6K. This setting corresponds to the second-stage training process, where mixed Poisson–Gaussian noise is introduced to simulate practical biomedical acquisition noise.

blocks.en: III-E No-Reference Evaluation on Real Biomedical Images
blocks.zh: III-E 关于真实生物医学的无参考评价 图像

blocks.en: Finally, we evaluate PP-Net on the W2S biomedical dataset under different averaging/noise levels, including avg1, avg4, avg16, and avg400. These settings represent different acquisition conditions and are used to examine the robustness of the proposed framework on real biomedical images. Since paired scattering-free ground truth is unavailable, PP-Net is compared with the degraded inputs and representative prior-based baselines using no-reference quality metrics.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们对W2S生物医学数据集的PP-Net进行不同平均/噪音水平的评价,包括avg1、avg4、avg16和avg400。 这些设置代表了不同的获取条件,并被用来审查关于真实生物医学图像的拟议框架是否健全。 由于配对的无散射地面真理是不存在的,因此PP-Net与退化的投入和具有代表性的先前基准相比,采用了无参考质量衡量标准。

blocks.en: NIQE and BRISQUE are adopted as no-reference metrics, where lower values indicate better perceptual quality. As reported in Table IV , PP-Net achieves the best NIQE scores across all four averaging levels, indicating improved naturalness and perceptual quality according to the NIQE criterion. The BRISQUE results are less consistent across different averaging levels, suggesting that different no-reference metrics may emphasize different image statistics. Therefore, the no-reference evaluation on real biomedical images is interpreted together with qualitative visual evidence.

blocks.en: III-F Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 三-F 关系研究

blocks.en: We further conduct ablation experiments to verify the main design choices of the proposed framework. The ablation study includes pipeline-level ablation, prior-design ablation, and training-strategy ablation.
blocks.zh: 我们还进行消毒试验,以核查拟议框架的主要设计选择。 通航研究包括管道级通航,前期设计通航,以及训练战略通航.

blocks.en: III-F 1 Pipeline-Level Ablation
blocks.zh: III-F 1 管道级别

blocks.en: Since the proposed framework consists of DFN-Net, ASAP, and GF-Net, we conduct module-level ablation experiments to analyze their individual effects and joint contribution.
blocks.zh: 由于拟议框架由DFN-Net、ASAP和GF-Net组成,我们进行模块级的消化试验,分析其个别效应和联合贡献。

blocks.en: We first evaluate the clean synthetic setting on the ITS dataset, where PP-Net P is used without DFN-Net. As shown in Table V , both ASAP and GF-Net contribute to restoration performance, while their combination achieves the best result. This verifies the effectiveness of coupling adaptive prior estimation with GF-Net refinement.
blocks.zh: 我们首先评价ITS数据集上的干净合成设置,PP-Net P在没有DFN-Net的情况下使用. 如表五所示,ASAP和GF-Net都有助于恢复性能,而两者的结合则能取得最佳结果。 这验证了将适应性先期估计与改进GF-Net相结合的有效性。

blocks.en: We then evaluate the noisy synthetic setting on the noisy ITS dataset, where the complete PP-Net is used. Table VI shows that the complete framework achieves the best performance. In particular, the comparison confirms that DFN-Net is important for stabilizing restoration under noisy degradation, while ASAP and GF-Net provide complementary benefits in prior-map recovery and detail refinement.

blocks.zh: III-F 2 前设计

blocks.en: Table VII shows that the proposed adaptive prior provides the most effective guidance among the compared prior variants. This result shows that the performance gain comes from both GF-Net refinement and improved ASAP-based scattering-map estimation, confirming the complementary roles of physical prior estimation and neural refinement.

blocks.en: III-F 3 Training-Strategy Ablation
blocks.zh: III-F 3 培训战略

blocks.en: Finally, we evaluate the proposed progressive synthetic training strategy.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们评价拟议的逐步综合培训战略。

blocks.en: As shown in Table VIII , progressive two-stage training achieves the best overall trade-off between noisy synthetic restoration performance and biomedical transferability. blocks.en: Overall, the experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of ASAP, the strong restoration performance of PP-Net P and PP-Net, and the necessity of the major design choices. In the next section, we further investigate the practical deployment feasibility of PP-Net on on Embedded Devices.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,这些实验证明了ASAP的有效性,PP-Net P和PP-Net的强劲恢复性能,以及主要设计选择的必要性. 在下一节,我们进一步调查嵌入式装置上的PP-Net的实际部署可行性。

blocks.en: IV PP-Net on Embedded Devices
blocks.zh: 关于嵌入式设备的IV PP-Net

blocks.en: To further evaluate the practical feasibility of PP-Net on embedded devices, we deploy the trained model on an RK3588-based platform. Rather than treating RK3588 as the only target hardware, we use it as a representative embedded device to examine whether the proposed network can be converted, quantized, and executed efficiently for edge-side biomedical image enhancement.
blocks.zh: 为了进一步评价PP-Net在嵌入式设备上的实际可行性,我们在基于RK3588的平台上部署训练有素的模型. 与其将RK3588作为唯一的目标硬件对待,我们用它作为具有代表性的嵌入式设备来检查所拟议的网络是否可以被转换,量化,并被高效地用于边缘侧生物医学图像增强.

blocks.en: IV-A Model Conversion and Quantization Workflow
blocks.zh: IV-A 模型转换和量化工作流程

blocks.en: The deployment follows a staged model-conversion workflow. The trained PP-Net model is first evaluated in PyTorch with FP32 precision, and the corresponding output is used as the desktop-side reference. The model is then exported to ONNX format and further converted into RKNN format for edge-side inference. The overall deployment route is summarized as follows:
blocks.zh: 部署遵循分阶段的模型转换工作流程。 训练有素的PP-Net模型首先在PyTorch中以FP32精度评价,相应的输出作为桌面侧参考. 该模型随后导出为ONNX格式,并进一步转换为RKNN格式,用于边缘侧推论. 总部署路线概述如下:

blocks.en: PyTorch FP32 ONNX RKNN RK3588 INT8
blocks.zh: PyTorch FP32 ONNX RKNN RK3588 INT8

blocks.en: After model conversion, INT8 post-training quantization is adopted for edge acceleration. Since biomedical image restoration is sensitive to intensity shifts, contrast distortion, and local structural artifacts, representative W2S images from different averaging levels are used for quantization calibration. This domain-specific calibration helps cover diverse noise levels and intensity distributions, thereby reducing quantization-induced degradation when the model is applied to real biomedical inputs.
blocks.zh: 模型转换后,INT8训练后量化被采用为边缘加速. 由于生物医学图像修复对强度变化,对比扭曲,以及局部结构文物敏感,因此不同平均水平的有代表性的W2S图像被用于量化校准. 这种域特异性校准有助于覆盖不同的噪声水平和强度分布,从而在模型应用于真正的生物医学输入时减少量化引起的降解.

blocks.en: Before final deployment, the converted RKNN model is checked against the original PyTorch implementation to ensure visual consistency. This step is important for biomedical image enhancement because small structural distortions introduced during model conversion or quantization may affect the visibility of local tissue details.
blocks.zh: 在最终部署前,将转换后的RKNN模型与原来的PyTorch执行对照检查,以确保视觉一致性. 这一步骤对于生物医学图像增强很重要,因为模型转换或量化过程中引入的小型结构扭曲可能影响局部组织细节的可见度.

blocks.en: V Conclusion
blocks.zh: 五 结论

blocks.en: This paper presented PP-Net, an edge-oriented hybrid physical-prior neural network for biomedical scattered-light removal. PP-Net integrates DFN-Net, ASAP, and GF-Net into a progressive network-prior-network pipeline, combining noise suppression, scattering-map estimation, prior-map recovery, and lightweight GF-Net refinement. To reduce the dependence on paired biomedical ground truth, we further developed a progressive synthetic training and cross-domain transfer strategy for real biomedical image inference.
blocks.zh: 本文介绍了PP-Net,这是一个面向边缘的混合物理前神经网络,用于生物医学散射光的清除. PP-Net将DFN-Net、ASAP和GF-Net整合到一个进步的网络-先行网络管道中,将噪声抑制、散射图估计、前行图恢复和轻量级GF-Net改进结合起来。 为了减少对配对生物医学地面真理的依赖,我们进一步为真正的生物医学影像推论制定了一个渐进的合成训练和跨域转移策略.

blocks.en: Experiments on multiple benchmark datasets demonstrated the effectiveness of ASAP, the strong restoration performance of PP-Net P , and the robustness of PP-Net under joint noise-and-scattering degradation. Direct transfer to real biomedical images also showed promising visual enhancement and competitive no-reference image quality results. Furthermore, RK3588 deployment with RKNN conversion and INT8 quantization achieved an average inference latency of approximately 200 ms per image over 360 test images, confirming efficient edge-side biomedical enhancement.
blocks.zh: 多个基准数据集的实验表明ASAP的有效性,PP-Net P的强恢复性能,以及PP-Net在联合噪声和散乱降解下的坚固性. 直接转移到真实的生物医学图像也显示出有希望的视觉增强和竞争性的无参考图像质量结果。 此外,RK3588部署的RKNN转换和INT8量化在360个测试图像上实现了平均每幅图像约200 ms的推论空隙,证实了边缘生物医学的有效增强。

blocks.en: Future work will focus on unsupervised biomedical domain adaptation, task-oriented clinical validation, and hardware-aware acceleration for real-time biomedical video enhancement on embedded devices.
blocks.zh: 今后的工作将侧重于无人监督的生物医学领域适应、面向任务的临床验证以及硬件意识加速,以便在嵌入式设备上进行实时生物医学视频增强。
